scope: Existing donor/adapt/dev PP records only; no new simulation, action branch, tuning or confirmation.
outcome: First detector passage 30m before stop line; current snapshots and competing outcomes retained.
primary: Reproduce original common-risk-set 10s analytic arrival-count MAE, then decompose per-flight false positives/negatives into timing, lane changes and competing outcomes.
timing_residual: end_s-t-remaining_m/speed_limit_mps, descriptive only among observed straight detector arrivals; +-1s tolerance for 1s observations.
past_speed: (remaining_m_at_t_minus_10-remaining_m_at_t)/10/limit; absent frame is missing, not a stop; no future snapshots.
replication: Per-seed summaries and equal-seed city means; donor/adapt descriptive replication; each vehicle sensitivity uses current straight snapshot closest to ETA=10s, never future status to select.
unchanged_gate: Original HOLD_DEVELOPMENT stays in force. Shared descriptive bias alone does not establish learned transfer or control gain.
